records.source: A blacksmith can break this open for you.
There is an aura of coldness around this crystal.
records.translation: 這顆水晶周圍環繞著冰冷氣息。

records.source: A pale, blind fish found in underground lakes.
records.translation: 地下湖泊中發現的蒼白盲魚。

records.source: This sharp, spicy root is said to increase vitality.
records.translation: 據說這種辛香根莖能增強活力。

records.source: A zesty soda known for its soothing effect on the stomach.
records.translation: 風味鮮明的汽水，以舒緩胃部的效果聞名。

records.source: Builds a nest on the underside of glaciers.
The original Glacierfish had a son...
records.translation: 原來那條冰川魚有個兒子……

records.source: A mixture of glass shards smoothed by centuries of ocean surf. These could have belonged to an ancient mosaic or necklace.
records.translation: 經數百年海浪磨平的玻璃碎片，可能曾屬於古代馬賽克或項鍊。

records.source: Sweet and satisfying... The sugar gives it a hint of caramel.
records.translation: 香甜又令人滿足……糖帶來淡淡焦糖風味。

records.source: Emits a constant light, and also increases your radius for collecting items.
records.translation: 持續發出光芒，並增加收集物品的範圍。

records.source: Soft cheese made from goat's milk.
records.translation: 以山羊奶製成的軟質乳酪。

records.source: Some types of Gobies can climb up waterfalls.
records.translation: 有些蝦虎魚能攀上瀑布。

records.source: Give this to a farm animal to permanently double its produce yield. Doesn't work on pigs.
records.translation: 餵給農場動物，可永久讓其產量加倍。對豬無效。

records.source: This is one tough nut to crack, but a professional might be able to break it open.
records.translation: 這顆硬果很難敲開，但專業人士或許能辦到。

records.source: A very rare and special egg with a solid gold shell.
records.translation: 蛋殼由純金構成的稀有特殊雞蛋。

records.source: A creepy golden mask probably used in an ancient magic ritual. A socket in the forehead contains a large purple gemstone.
records.translation: 令人不安的金色面具，可能曾用於古代魔法儀式。額頭凹槽中嵌有大型紫色寶石。

records.source: It's valuable but has no other purpose.
records.translation: 價值很高，除此之外沒有其他用途。

records.source: It's a golden slab with hieroglyphs and pictures emblazoned onto the front.
records.translation: 正面刻有象形文字和圖畫的金色板片。

records.source: To the parrots of Ginger Island, this nut is the finest delicacy.
records.translation: 對薑島鸚鵡而言，這種核果是最頂級的美味。

records.source: A precious ore that can be smelted into bars.
records.translation: 可冶煉成金錠的貴重礦石。

records.source: Break apart to obtain gold ore.
A rare, delicious and savory salt.
A speckled Mineral that is commonly used in construction.
records.translation: 帶有斑點、常用於建築的礦物。

records.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 10 days to grow, but keeps producing after that. Grows on a trellis.
records.translation: 秋季播種，十天成熟，之後持續收成。依附棚架生長。

records.source: You will now run a lot faster through grass and crops.
records.translation: 現在穿過青草和作物時能跑得快很多。

records.source: Place this on your farm to start a new patch of grass.
records.translation: 放在農場上即可種出一片新青草。

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
records.translation: 鋪在地面上可建造小徑或美化地板。

records.source: A juicy little bean with a cool, crisp snap.
records.translation: 多汁的小豆莢，口感清涼爽脆。

records.source: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
records.translation: 可能含有纖維或混合種子。

records.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
records.translation: 可在史萊姆孵化器中孵化。

records.source: A pleasant, energizing beverage made from lightly processed tea leaves.
records.translation: 以輕度加工茶葉製成、令人愉悅又提神的飲品。
